fields.28210: Use Python 3.13 and Node 24. Install backend/requirements.lock.txt in a virtual environment and run npm --prefix frontend ci. Generate the synthetic data with tools/generate_dataset.py. Run scripts/verify_local.py --include-mcp with the virtual-environment Python for backend, frontend and eight MCP-tool checks. Follow README.md to start the app, or deploy/README.md for Docker. In the UI, run clear defects, clean board, glare, registration failure, missing second view and budget-limited regions. Download the report and inspect the event trail. With an API running, python -m tools.export_demo_evidence --out NEW_DIRECTORY exports all six actual demo traces. Current metrics and limitations are in docs/TECHNICAL_REPORT.md and docs/FINAL_AUDIT.md. Source is public. The required portal ZIP is generated with tools/package_submission.py --portal and includes SOURCE_MANIFEST.json plus hashes. AWS OpenCV execution at commit 6281c2b is documented in docs/AWS_EXECUTION_2026-10-27.md; final audit fixes postdate that run. Latest local checks and 30-case benchmark are in docs/FINAL_CHECK_2026-10-27.md. This is a supervised synthetic demonstration, not validated manufacturing inspection. Public synthetic-only demo: https://decided-attributes-southwest-africa.trycloudflare.com. Uploads are disabled there; use the local install for custom images. The URL is temporary and depends on the team Mac staying online. Unlisted video: https://youtu.be/ucM4NiEHInE.
